  • Method Details

    • resolveTravelDirection

      MovementDirectionStrategy resolveTravelDirection(List<Piece> blockPieces, Board board)
      Chooses the direction. The choice is made once when the blockade forms, and it is reused while the blockade stays grouped (T-4, T-5).
      Parameters:
      blockPieces - the pieces of the blockade
      board - the board that gives the track
      Returns:
      the direction in which the blockade travels
